fields.Name: PreventSelfApproval
fields.Comments: When true, a decision on an approval task (a task whose type has IsApproval set) is accepted only from one of the task's assignees, recorded as that assignee's own decision, and never from the person who created the task (bc-aidp-next-golive#320). Checked on the server for every path that records a decision: the approval panel, the Tasks inbox and other apps' server code. True is the default — the guard is on unless this is explicitly set to false, which accepts every decision unchecked.

fields.Name: SelfApprovalExemptRole
fields.Comments: The NAME of the MJ role whose holders may decide an approval task they created themselves while PreventSelfApproval is true. They must still be one of its assignees. Empty exempts nobody. A name that is not a role exempts nobody and is logged.
